title: A generalization of a result of Hegedüs
summary: A famous result of P. Hegedüs describes the structure of finite rational $\{2,5\}$-groups. In this paper, we show how Hegedüs' proof can be used to obtain a similar result for the more general situation of a finite rational $2$-group acting faithfully and with the eigenvector property on a f.d $\mathbb{F}_p$-vector space with $p\geq 5$.
